standard_prerequisites.name: The trivial subbundle case, and the formula for the Chern classes of a twist by an invertible sheaf
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, labels lemma-get-rid-of-trivial-subbundle (proof line 7945, claimed as S14-algebra-trivial-subbundle) and lemma-chern-classes-E-tensor-L (proof line 7950, claimed as S14-algebra-chern-classes-twist)
standard_prerequisites.use: The first gives the equality of the Chern classes of the two modules after twisting by the inverse of the subbundle, and the second converts that equality into the displayed binomial relation comparing the unknown classes of the extension and of the quotient.

core_obligations: Rewrite the claim as the recursion determining the Chern classes of the extension from those of the quotient and of the invertible subbundle (proof lines 7942-7944).

Derive the relation by twisting: by the trivial subbundle case the Chern classes of the twist of the extension and of the quotient agree, and substituting the tensor product formula gives the displayed equality of binomial sums (proof lines 7945-7957).

Conclude by uniqueness: the recursion gives one solution of that equation, and the assertion follows once one knows it is the only solution, which the author leaves to the reader (proof lines 7958-7961).
proof_roadmap: Twist and substitute the tensor product formula (proof lines 7945-7957).
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves multiplicativity of the total Chern class for a short exact sequence whose subbundle has rank one (statement lines 7924-7940, tag 02UF-adjacent). The proof reformulates the claim as a recursion, twists by the inverse of the subbundle to reduce to the trivial subbundle case, substitutes the formula for the Chern classes of a twist into the resulting equality, and concludes by uniqueness of the solution of that recursion. The twist and the substitution are the substance, so the claim is H2.
